name: Ilkrud Magthrull's Tome
summary: At Fire Scar Shrine, Delgren the Purifier turns his attention to Ilkrud Magthrull's Tome. Its pages link the warlock to the cultists at the Tower of Althalaxx.

sections.title: A Grimoire of Corruption
sections.body: At Fire Scar Shrine in southwestern Ashenvale, Ilkrud Magthrull holds ground poisoned by demonic influence. The formidable orc warlock is surrounded by summoned minions. His personal tome records foul rituals and shadowy communications. Delgren the Purifier, an Argent Dawn paladin, has long known Magthrull is there. The book is urgent to recover because it links the warlock to the dark cultists gathering at the Tower of Althalaxx.

sections.title: Unraveling the Cult
sections.body: After Magthrull is slain, his tome is brought to Delgren at Maestra's Post. Delgren studies the warlock's writings to understand the network coordinating demonic activity across the borders of Darkshore and Ashenvale. The text offers vital intelligence on the shadowy conspirators directing the corruption spreading through northern Kalimdor.

faq.answer: Ilkrud Magthrull owns the tome. The powerful orc warlock is established among the demonic ruins of Fire Scar Shrine in southwestern Ashenvale.
The tome is recovered from Ilkrud Magthrull at Fire Scar Shrine, south of the Shrine of Aessina in Ashenvale.

faq.q: Why does Delgren the Purifier want the book?
faq.answer: Delgren seeks to study Magthrull's writings and uncover the ties between local demon-worshipers and the cultists at the Tower of Althalaxx.

faq.q: What happens after the tome is recovered?
aliases: what does delgren do with the book
faq.answer: At Maestra's Post, Delgren examines the text to decipher Magthrull's demonic communications and learn how to dismantle the cult's network.

angles.text: As a paladin, you help Brother Delgren, a fellow warrior of the Holy Light who opposes shadow and corruption in Ashenvale's wilderness.
As a warlock, you can study Magthrull's grimoire, which records dark bindings and the subjugation of voidwalkers and succubi at the tainted Fire Scar Shrine.
